verdict.rationale: Jan is local-first: it documents running entirely on the user's hardware and letting users switch between local and cloud models. That effectively lets a user keep data on their own device instead of sending it to a provider. There is no documented control for choosing a storage location, region or residency for stored data. missing for 10: explicit data-storage location or residency settings, documentation of where chats and data are stored, region selection for cloud-connected data, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Privacy First**: Everything runs locally when you want it to
an application ecosystem that runs entirely on your hardware
No vendor lock-in: Switch freely between local and frontier models.
